kernel.role: DONOR ONLY: A04BR3/MT8167 kernel; not a validated Galaxy A03s kernel and must not be packaged for SM-A037F.

bootshim.role: SM-A037F MT6765 diagnostic shim, built for Cortex-A53; linker/build hardening added, but XNU handoff, hardware behavior and UART output remain unverified.

xnu.role: Pinned upstream XNU source for porting experiments. Upstream source only; not yet built for SM-A037F, not a supported MT6765 platform, and not a bootable kernel artifact.
